description: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.The successful candidate will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations while driving operational excellence and financial performance. This role offers a significant opportunity to make a lasting impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting, supported by a competitive compensation package.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated leadership abilities with a strong track record of operational success and regulatory compliance.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in financial management and budget oversight.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Remote Radiologist to join our specialized diagnostic imaging practice. This full-time role focuses exclusively on Workers' Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases, offering a unique opportunity to apply your expertise in a focused environment. We do not handle major medical insurances or Medicare/Medicaid, allowing for streamlined operations and a clear case focus.

This position offers a compensation structure that is heavily bonus-driven, with attractive per-read rates. Candidates must be able to work weekends to meet case demands. We are looking for a professional who thrives in a remote setting and is committed to providing high-quality diagnostic interpretations for our specific patient population.
requirements: Current New York State Radiologist license
Demonstrated experience with Workers' Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is heavily bonus-driven, with per-read rates of $50 for MRI, $30 for CT, and $10 for X-Ray. Experience in Workers' Compensation or No-Fault/Lien cases is essential.
